entities.name: GDF7
observations: Nearby variant rs3072 at 2p24.1 was associated with Barrett's esophagus susceptibility: OR 1.14, 95% CI 1.09–1.18, P=1.8×10^-11, in 10,158 cases and 21,062 controls with discovery and replication phases.

entities.name: TBX5
observations: Nearby variant rs2701108 at 12q24.21 was associated with Barrett's esophagus susceptibility: reported OR 0.90, 95% CI 0.86–0.93, P=7.5×10^-9; the opposite allele is the risk-increasing direction.

entities.name: Barrett's esophagus
observations: Germline polymorphisms near GDF7 and TBX5 were associated with susceptibility to developing Barrett's esophagus, rather than being established solely as progression markers.

entities.name: rs3072
observations: Variant near GDF7 at 2p24.1; Barrett's esophagus association OR 1.14, 95% CI 1.09–1.18, P=1.8×10^-11.

entities.name: rs2701108
observations: Variant near TBX5 at 12q24.21; reported Barrett's esophagus association OR 0.90, 95% CI 0.86–0.93, P=7.5×10^-9, with the alternate allele increasing risk.

entities.name: PMID:25447851
observations: Gastroenterology 2015 primary GWAS and case-control study of Barrett's esophagus susceptibility; 10,158 cases and 21,062 controls.

entities.name: PMID:26783083
observations: Cancer Medicine 2016 follow-up tested rs3072 and rs2701108 in Barrett's esophagus and esophageal adenocarcinoma samples; both variants were also associated with esophageal adenocarcinoma, but quantitative replication details were unavailable in the retrieved abstract.
